hooks.text: Seven Earth-sized planets are crammed inside the orbit of Mercury.
One tiny star system fits seven Earths inside Mercury's orbit.
These seven planets sit closer than Mercury but stay frozen.

title: Seven Earths Packed inside Mercury's Orbit
description: The TRAPPIST-1 system fits seven Earth-sized worlds into a space smaller than Mercury's orbit, creating a world divided between fire and ice.

beats.text: Seven Earth-sized planets are crammed inside the orbit of Mercury.
beats.visual: comparison diagram of TRAPPIST-1 system and our inner solar system, 2017
queries: TRAPPIST-1 vs Solar System orbit diagram

beats.text: They circle a red dwarf star barely larger than Jupiter.
beats.visual: artist concept of the TRAPPIST-1 star compared to Jupiter, 2017
queries: red dwarf star size comparison Jupiter

beats.text: On the world TRAPPIST-1e, one full year lasts just six days.
beats.visual: artist impression of the exoplanet TRAPPIST-1e, 2017

beats.text: It stays permanently locked with one side always facing its sun.
beats.visual: diagram explaining tidal locking of a planet around a star

beats.text: One half is scorched desert; the other is frozen night.
beats.visual: artist concept of TRAPPIST-1e surface showing the day-night divide
queries: exoplanet surface artist impression fire and ice

beats.text: Electric currents from intense stellar winds may be stripping its air.
beats.visual: illustration of stellar winds hitting a planet's atmosphere, 2024
queries: planetary atmosphere stripping by stellar wind concept

beats.text: This world hangs between a lush paradise and a barren, airless stone.
beats.visual: artist's split-view concept of TRAPPIST-1e as habitable vs airless
queries: rocky exoplanet with thin atmosphere concept

beats.text: All while remaining just one of seven worlds packed inside Mercury's orbit.
beats.visual: wide artist concept of the full TRAPPIST-1 planetary system
